mapper.select: SELECT b.preset_key FROM afv_media_preset_binding b JOIN afv_system_config c ON c.config_key = CONCAT('art_preset_url:', b.preset_key) AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE b.media_id = #{mediaId} AND c.config_value = #{reference} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_media_preset_binding(preset_key, media_id, published_by) VALUES (#{key}, #{id}, #{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE media_id = VALUES(media_id), published_by = VALUES(published_by), published_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
